note: Arthur's kit, granted when a contract is accepted. RDR2 has no suppressors: the 'silenced' revolver works by zeroing contract peds' hearing while a contract is active, so shots do not blow our detection system - the joke is mechanical, not audio. Funny labels are OUR words; the weapons underneath are real RDR2 assets (names verified in decompiled scripts, build 1491.50).

rows.label: Silenced Revolver (Very Sneaky)
rows.mechanic: silencer: while contract active, contract peds get SET_PED_HEARING_RANGE 0; gunfire does not raise our detection states
rows.funnyNote: It is not quiet. It is polite.

rows.label: Standard Issue Revolver
rows.mechanic: given to spawned guards (targets unarmed unless behavior says otherwise)
rows.funnyNote: Guards get the same gun. They just aim worse.

rows.label: Fiber Wire (Horsehair)
rows.mechanic: back-takedown: when behind a target within 1.8m and unseen, kills silently via APPLY_DAMAGE_TO_PED without combat state
rows.funnyNote: Arthur braided it himself. It is mostly rein.

rows.label: Ruby-Tipped Throwing Knives
rows.mechanic: vanilla throwable; counted as silent elimination for scoring if it kills a target un witnessed
rows.funnyNote: Ruby tips. Because subtlety is a spectrum.

rows.label: Rubber Duck (Do Not Feed)
rows.mechanic: vanilla thrown dynamite; loud, lethal, ruins Silent Assassin - kept for laughs
rows.funnyNote: Diana explicitly forbade this duck. Arthur brought three.
